Para Hand, Júpiter es el planeta del cre: For Hand, Jupiter is the planet of growth and expansion: life flows more easily in the area it is transiting. His advice is not to overdo it, because Jupiter enlarges everything, excesses included, and you should be careful what you wish for because you are likely to get it.
Para Hand, Saturno señala el área de tu: For Hand, Saturn points to the area of your life that is being examined and put to the test. Although it feels like an external force, he sees it as the result of how you yourself structure your world: what Saturn takes away is usually what you no longer need, and what it consolidates is what truly supports you.
Para Hand, Urano trae lo inesperado: cam: For Hand, Uranus brings the unexpected: sudden changes that challenge rigid structures. It is not bad in the traditional sense, except to the extent that you resist the new; it asks for flexibility in the area it is transiting.
Para Hand, Neptuno disuelve lo que Satur: For Hand, Neptune dissolves what Saturn builds: the sense of reality, the ego, and certainties. It can bring confusion and disillusionment, but also idealism and inspiration; it asks you to protect your clarity and not to believe what is only a wish.
Para Hand, Plutón transforma: derriba lo: For Hand, Pluto transforms: it tears down what can no longer be fixed and builds something new in its place. It does not speak of literal death but of the “death” of what ceases to be. It asks you to accept change rather than resist it, so that it does not build up until it becomes explosive.
